answer: Sybil resistance by escrow. Every identity that wants to mine locks a bond in a shared vault, and the vault slashes it the moment two of its keys submit the same answer. Cloning one falcon is cheap; feeding a hundred into the same vault is not, because each extra mouth raises the stake at risk while the reward pool stays fixed. Honest capacity pays, fake capacity starves, and the oasis stays open to whoever can afford to lose.
